newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Amalgamated takes 26 pct of Hyundai Oil.
newsitem.headline: Amalgamated takes 26 pct of Hyundai Oil.

text.p: A Republic of Ireland-based investment vehicle, Amalgamated Techonology Plc, has taken a 26 percent stake in South Korea's Hyundai Oil Refinery Co, a senior official of the Hyundai Group unit said on Monday.
Kim Jung-rae, director of corporate planning, said Amalgamated bought 180.4 billion won worth of new shares issued by Hyundai Oil.

Amalgamated's ownership of Hyundai's expanded share capital brought its stake in the refiner to 26 percent, he said. Hyundai Oil now has paid-in capital of 711.4 billion won. Kim said Amalgamated Technology would not have any say in the management of Hyundai Oil.
"We were looking for a suitable investment company willing to help fund our new projects including a BTX plant," said Kim. "And we found Amalgamated Technology."
